notes: Spec/inventory disagreement: spec counts 35 colour variables; src/index.css @theme defines 30 colour tokens (2 fonts + 30 colours + 1 shadow + 3 breakpoints = 36 entries). Built 30, one for one with the theme (story 7). Counts check uses 30.
Mode name chosen: Default (spec fixes one mode but gives no name).

Variable scopes follow how the code uses each token: fills FRAME_FILL+SHAPE_FILL, text TEXT_FILL, borders STROKE_COLOR; ink/sheet/paper carry several; marker-ring and observation-ring (box-shadow rings) add EFFECT_COLOR; unused amber/amber-pale default to fills, water to fill+stroke.
Page 1 (0:1) was renamed Foundations rather than deleted, so the original page ID is kept.
Weight mapping: 400 Regular, 600 Semibold, 700/750/800 Bold (SF Pro Heavy exists but the spec allows only Regular, Semibold, Bold).

FONT SUBSTITUTION (build decision, 2026-10-28): the spec's body face SF Pro appears in figma.listAvailableFontsAsync() but cannot be loaded or rendered in the build runtime: every SF Pro text node reports hasMissingFont=true and width 0, bound or unbound, while Literata renders. Inter (present, the metric stand-in for SF) is used for body text instead. font/sans holds the value 'Inter' so one edit in Figma desktop (where SF Pro is installed) switches every bound text node back; the Inter style 'Semi Bold' corresponds to SF Pro 'Semibold'. The font assertion check therefore accepts Literata and Inter. First SF Pro sheet (9:2) was removed and rebuilt as 11:3.
Text recipe: resize() reverts textAutoResize to fixed, so wrapping text sets HEIGHT again after resize+characters (helpers patched; specimen fixed in place).
inventory.md is committed alongside spec.md and state.json in the phase-1 commit because the spec names it as a companion; it is not otherwise changed.
Wiring a TEXT property to a variant's text layer replaces each variant's characters with the property default (Button variants all read 'Label'); instances set their own label, as the screens do.
Nested instances exposed (isExposedInstance): Export button in Top bar, Count chip in Tabs, so their text properties are editable from the parent instance.
Zoom control glyphs are Inter Bold (Leaflet uses Lucida Console); formula text in the Method dialog is Inter (code uses a mono stack): only Literata and Inter are allowed in the file.

Candidate card: position and pool rank are text properties of the exposed nested Position badge and Pool rank chip (Figma cannot bind a parent TEXT property into a nested instance); name, index, ID and round trip are direct properties; Caution is a boolean on the chip row. Per-status chip colours are instance overrides inside each variant.

Legend, detail and method closes reuse Button/Kind=Dismiss with text size and colour overrides (17 px #646e5d; 20 px #5f7154 in a 28 px #eff2e9 circle; 22 px ink-soft in a 34 px paper circle). Fatal error's Reload uses Kind=Primary (code: pad 13/10, 12 px topbar-text).
Method dialog paragraphs with in-line bold ranges report fontName as mixed; the font check must read styled segments.

HANDOFF 2026-10-28: session moved to the cloud mid-phase-2. Remaining: Detail panel, Sidebar, Components review frame, phase-2 commit, screens (phase 3), checks (phase 4), retro. Hand-over note in the side-session notes folder (figma-library-handoff.md).

RUNTIME LIMIT (cloud session, 2026-10-28): resize() on a node nested inside an instance is silently ignored (width unchanged, no error) while padding, itemSpacing, layoutSizing FILL/FIXED, fills, strokes, cornerRadius, effects, fontSize, fontName, letterSpacing and paragraphSpacing overrides on nested children all apply, and resizing the instance itself works. Component bar therefore sets its fill width through the track: the fill rectangle is FILL-width and the nested track frame’s paddingRight = width × (1 − score/100) (main component default 80%, i.e. paddingRight 57.2 of 286). The spec’s “fill width set by resizing” is amended in spec.md; a designer in Figma desktop can still drag the fill.

Detail panel (24:131): 330 wide, hugs its content (2048 px with EP-04). Header gradient stops are literal #f8f3e7 → #fffefa (gradient stops cannot bind to variables). The Pool rank chip in the header carries the inventory’s detail-only overrides (pad 3/6, 11 px text) as instance overrides; the cautions Callout overrides pad 9/11, gap 3, radius 0, eyebrow 9 px / 4% tracking and body paragraphSpacing 6 (one paragraph per caution); the field log Select row overrides the nested select to #ffffff fill, #d3ddc8 stroke and pad 8/10. Vertical margins from the CSS are encoded as padding on named wrapper frames (CSS margin collapse applied). The Route status property is one text node whose first 13 characters are Semi Bold; an instance that sets a different value may lose that range (Figma keeps styling only for unchanged text). Exposed nested instances (19): Pool rank chip, Caution chip, 4 Component bars, 8 Metric tiles, Callout / Cautions, 3 Planning chips, Select row / Field status.

Segmented control main component (15:44) corrected during phase 2: the source’s preset buttons are `px-0.5 py-1.5` (2 px horizontal, 6 px vertical). The phase-2 local build had read the inventory’s “pad 2/6” (horizontal/vertical per its own notation) the other way round. Control height is now 35 (was 27). The scope toggle in the Sidebar is an instance with overrides: pad 8/5, segment radius 5, fill #e9ede5 (no token within 2 per channel), no stroke, control radius 8, segment 3 hidden, labels Nearby / All in Semi Bold, pressed pill = sheet with 0 1px 4px #183a2420.

Sidebar (28:233): fixed 326 × 814 (900 − 86 header), paper fill, 1 px line-strong right border, clips. Sidebar header and Tabs (exposed) on top; the two tab panels are FILL-height frames that clip, mirroring the app’s scrolling tabpanel, so the Candidates panel shows the first two and a half cards and the Map layers panel ends inside the model-scores group, exactly as the 814 px viewport would. Booleans “Map layers panel” (default false) and “Candidates panel” (default true) toggle their visibility. Compact model-score rows: Layer switch Off instances resized to 29 px (instance resize works), nested row set to FILL height, label 11 px. Layer swatch colours are instance fill overrides from inventory section 39; Mapped water binds to color/water exactly. Checked rows follow the Terrain preset (trails, roads, trailheads, boundary, contours, relief, water).

Candidate list in the Sidebar: scout order from public/data/candidates.geojson (EP-04, EP-05, EP-03, EP-01, EP-06, EP-02), position badge = list position, pool rank chip = Nearby #rank, index = Math.round(score) / 100, round trip = roundtrip_lower_bound_miles.toFixed(1) + ' mi minimum round trip' (format.ts). EP-04 is State=Selected; all Field status=To scout. No JP context candidates, no observation data.

Review frame “Components / Review” (29:363, 1840 × 4785, paper fill, 9 px muted uppercase captions bound to font/sans): Top bar; every plain component once; all 7 Button kinds with realistic labels; all 4 Layer switch states; both Notice states; Legend panel, Export menu panel, Map loading; Candidate card in 4 of its 12 variants (Default/To scout, Selected/Scouted, Focused/Camera placed, Default/Ruled out); Confirm dialog, Fatal error; the Sidebar twice (Candidates and Map layers, with the exposed Tabs switched); Detail panel; Method dialog. Main components stay outside the frame.
